item.title: A closer look at a BGP anomaly in Venezuela
item.description:
📝 Background: BGP route leaks First, let’s revisit what a BGP route leak is. Route leak by AS8048 (CANTV) Now that we have reminded ourselves what a route leak is in BGP, let’s examine what was hypothesized in the newsletter post. This is definitely a route leak.

item.title: AI misses nearly one-third of breast cancers, study finds
item.description:
📝 3 years, recently diagnosed with breast cancer, investigators evaluated how well an AI-based computer-aided diagnosis system (AI-CAD) performed when reading mammograms and breast MRI scans. AI Misses More Cancers in Dense Breast Tissue The results were striking: 127 cancers, 30. Added value of diffusion-weighted imaging in detecting breast cancer missed by artificial intelligence-based mammography.
🔗 Read more: https://www.emjreviews.com/radiology/news/ai-misses-nearly-one-third-of-breast-cancers-study-finds/
